summary.headline: Combustion of Saturn and Jupiter
summary.text: Astrological mundane predictions for Saturn’s combustion in Pisces and Jupiter’s combustion in Aries, including earthquakes, weather, disease, warfare, plunder, political unrest, and regional effects across Transoxiana, Kufa, the Hejaz, Isfahan, Fars, Khuzestan, Babylon, Khorasan, and among Arab and Tajik populations. Planetary conjunctions or aspects with Mars, Venus, Mercury, Jupiter, and the Moon modify the forecasts.
